analysis.reasonEn: Recent 5-day decline of -3.4%, RSI entering extreme oversold territory at 32.2. With ADX at 19.8 indicating no established trend, the -DI (40.4) is significantly higher than +DI (19.0), showing downward pressure dominance. MACD histogram continues to worsen. Volume ratio at 0.35 of the 5-day average indicates subdued activity. Positioned at 26.5% of its 52-week range, near the lower bound. Given the high volatility inherent in a 3x leveraged product, a wait-and-see approach is warranted.
